label: Connection
description: The PostHog project your store events are sent to.

fields.label: Project API key
fields.description: PostHog → Project settings → Project API key. This key can only send events; it cannot read your PostHog data.

fields.label: Send test event
fields.hint: Sends one "Swell Test Event" to your PostHog project to check the connection.
fields.description: Save the settings first: actions are disabled while there are unsaved changes.
